card.name: Kiba / Dinaka
card.profile: Peak of Pedi/Northern Sotho musical expression; men each blow an end-blown aluminium pipe (naka) of a different pitch to produce a harmonized descending melody with energetic dance; women’s version (kosša ya dikhuru) involves kneeling and torso movement. Survived apartheid as a migrant genre. Dual music+dance.
